verdict.rationale: Brex ships AI features (audit and review agents, AI assistants, an MCP server), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use control for AI models. The AI-feature and MCP descriptions are about other capabilities and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
